name: «Покажем до оплаты»: what the extra money buys, shown on in-stock pianos (Muzzone, digital pianos to 31.12.2026), revision 2
big_idea:
Revision 2. Every listing in the category says «88 клавиш». In-stock prices run from 232 960 ₸ to 754 990 ₸ on the models we need to move. Buyers can't see what the extra money buys, and the old answer, «listen to the difference», does not survive a weak phone mic, platform compression and a phone speaker. So the hero no longer asks viewers to hear anything. It **shows the differences a phone camera captures reliably**:
- key travel when a finger presses and releases;
- what is on the floor (stand, 1 pedal or 3, a bench or none);
- headphones going in, then a silent room;
- the depth and look of the body (cabinet vs portable).

Each claim about a model is shown only once it is in that model's spec card in the ledger.

**Platform idea «Покажем до оплаты».**
- Device, frame 1 of every episode: top-down, two in-stock pianos side by side, one finger pressing the same key on each with the real key thud. On-screen question «[разница] — за что?», with no ₸ figure in the first 2 seconds (G4).
- Fixed end frame: «Астана, Кажымукана 14 · WhatsApp: слово ___».

**Episodes go to the overstocked SKUs first** (site stock read 2026-10-08):
- Kurzweil CUP E1 vs CUP M1: both 637 520 ₸, 3 units each. «Одна цена — два разных пианино».
- Estrada EDP-220BK (9 units) vs Casio PX-S1100 (5 units): a 130 030 ₸ gap.
- EDP-220BK vs Casio AP-300WE (4 units): more than 3× the price.
- PX-770 vs AP-270 (3 and 5 units) moves to the YouTube model-name search line. STAKES-11's 2 M ₸ Dexibell is dropped.

**Around the hero:**
- «Перед оплатой»: a real buyer's checklist covering keys, stand and pedals, and headphones.
- «Вопрос родителя»: honest answers, including a teacher-question episode.
- A December gift series.
- A local distribution track. Music-school teachers and class parent chats get a forwardable card with its own code.

**Conversion layer:** one WA code per video, a pinned «Как заказать пианино» video, WA Status for existing contacts, and instalment pricing («от X ₸/мес»). Instalment pricing is used only if the owner confirms the exact Kaspi or bank terms.

**Timeline** (type S, back-planned from 31.12):
- explore 12–25 Oct;
- focus 26 Oct–22 Nov;
- scale 23 Nov–20 Dec;
- push 21–31 Dec.

**SMP status:** provisional (no chat evidence yet). It is locked or replaced from data on 22 Nov.
single_minded_message_ru: Покажем, за что вы платите, — до того, как заплатите.
why_this_wins:
This is not a forecast. Text judges are near chance on short-form (L001, ρ 0.07 for retail), so this is a better-built set of shots on goal. What changed, and why it is the better bet:

1. **The format can now keep its promise.** The hero shows key travel, pedals, stand, headphones and body depth. A weak phone films these reliably. A 4-second sound A/B through phone mic → compression → phone speaker would mostly get «одинаково» and push viewers to the cheapest listing anywhere. Sound comparison survives only as one exploration episode, and only if it passes a staff blind playback test on a cheap Android and the boss approves after listening.

2. **Reach goes to the stock that has to move.** Week 1 is Kurzweil CUP E1/M1 (3+3 units), week 2 is EDP-220BK (9) vs PX-S1100 (5), week 3 adds AP-300WE (4). Together these are 24 units in the first three weeks of hero content. Nothing promotes a 1-unit 2 M ₸ piano.

3. **We don't talk buyers out of our own Casio stock.** Casio's Almaty-only service stays fully disclosed in the WA reply, if asked, and on the trust highlight in exact site wording. It is no longer a hook line in a weekly Status. The warranty line in videos waits for the owner to confirm how the shop handles repairs.

4. **It uses the local buying lever.** Instalments («от X ₸/мес») are now owner question #1 in week 0. If they are confirmed, they reframe the budget, gift and «а если бросит?» videos. The return-policy angle that helped nobody is gone.

5. **Distribution is local, not CIS musicians.** A teacher track (ДМШ teachers → class parent chats, coded ПЕДАГОГ1/РОДИТЕЛИ1), forwardable vertical utility cuts, and the Astana address on every end frame point reach at buyers in Astana.

6. **The shoot is realistic.** Each session uses ≤2 pianos, ≤3 setups and ≤10 minutes, with a preset/volume/framing checklist taped to each piano. That is four small October sessions instead of one impossible 17-minute marathon.

7. **It fixes our known failure mode.** Demos are tied to a buyer's money question (L006), there are no price slides (L005), and a YouTube model-name search line reuses the footage (L002/L004) at zero extra minutes.

series.name: «Покажем до оплаты» (HERO): two in-stock pianos, one visible difference per beat, the price gap told inside the story
series.role:
Reach plus consideration. Arm A1 (E17 counter-convention + E08 price anatomy). Fixed ritual: top-down frame of the same key pressed on both pianos with the real key thud, caption «[разница] — за что?» (no ₸ before 2 s), end frame «Астана, Кажымукана 14 · WhatsApp: слово ___». Length 12–20 s.

Only differences that are both in the ledger spec cards and visible on camera are shown. Sound is never the argument. Comment driver: «Какое бы поставили дома — и почему?» This is a harmless choice question, not a guess.

Episodes, in order of stock:
- BLIND-01, rebuilt: Kurzweil CUP E1 vs CUP M1, same 637 520 ₸;
- ANAT-02, rebuilt: EDP-220BK vs PX-S1100, a 130 030 ₸ gap;
- STAKES-11, rebuilt: EDP-220BK vs AP-300WE, more than 3× the price, no Dexibell.

Further pairs are carded weekly from the 14 in-stock SKUs.
series.cadence: 1–2 posts/week in weeks 1–10 (Thompson R4, cap 50%); 1–2/week in the push with conversion CTAs

series.name: «Перед оплатой» (UTILITY): a real buyer's checklist plus budget tiers, cut to forward into parent chats
series.role:
Saves and forwards. Arm A2 (E06 + E20/E11).

CHECK-03 is rewritten as a true pre-purchase check:
1. Are the keys weighted / hammer action? (a finger pressing a key)
2. What comes in the box: stand, 3 pedals or 1, bench? (shown on PX-S1100 vs a cabinet model)
3. Is there a headphone output? (headphones go in)

Model-specific answers appear only from ledger spec cards. The generic checks are worded and approved by the store.

TIERS-07 shows three real price points: EDP-220BK 232 960 ₸ / PX-S1100 362 990 ₸ / AP-300WE 754 990 ₸, each with «от X ₸/мес» only if instalments are confirmed.

Both are made as a 9:16 short and as a still card for WhatsApp parent chats.
series.cadence: 1 post/week; 2/week if A2 leads on saves per 1k or codes

series.name: «Вопрос родителя / вопрос педагогу» (RESPONSE): honest answers to real doubts, plus an expert invite to teachers
series.role:
Comments and parent-chat shares. Arm A3 (E05 + E15/E19). No children on camera.

- FIRSTYEAR-15 is rewritten: «А если через полгода бросит?» → «честно: не знает никто» → start at the entry tier (EDP-220BK 232 960 ₸), or pay in parts (only with confirmed terms) → «напишите бюджет». The return-policy angle is removed.
- TEACH-09 is new, and the local distribution hook: «Педагоги, что советуете родителям — молоточковая механика обязательна?». It is a question with no claim, because INS7 has T=0.
- From week 2, E19 replies quote the best teacher answers (anonymised public comments). After the chat sample arrives, real WA questions are added.

series.name: «Подарок весом с холодильник» (SEASONAL, December)
series.role:
Shares (the partner or grandparent you plot presents with) and December conversion. Arm A4 (E12 POV). Box shots are filmed in the showroom in the week 7 session, not in week 1.

Published from 2026-12-01 only after Q3 gives December reserve and delivery cut-offs. Uses «от X ₸/мес» only if instalments are confirmed. If Q3 never clears, the slots go to gift-tier hero episodes with pickup and published delivery facts only.

series.name: «Статус для своих» + teacher/parent card (CONVERSION and LOCAL DISTRIBUTION)
series.role:
Reaches music-school parents through people who already have the shop's number, and through teachers.

- STATUS-18 is rebuilt as the new CHECK-03 points plus the address. The Almaty line is removed from anything recurring.
- A forwardable teacher/parent card (code РОДИТЕЛИ1) is made from the same cut.
- Pinned «Как заказать пианино» video, using facts only: code word → model → 3-working-day reserve → pickup at Кажымукана 14 or free RK delivery over 100 000 ₸ → Kaspi QR / Kaspi Pay / cards / cash (plus instalments if confirmed).
series.cadence: WA Status weekly; opted-in broadcast at most every 2 weeks (weekly 21–31 Dec); teacher card refreshed monthly

series.name: «Модель vs модель» (YouTube search line)
series.role:
Evergreen search capture for buyers in the research phase (L002/L004). Plain titles, e.g. «Casio PX-770 vs Casio Celviano AP-270 — сравнение» (both ≥3 units per the site crawl, so they qualify). Also «Estrada EDP-220BK vs Casio PX-S1100», «Kurzweil CUP E1 vs CUP M1».

Longer takes, and line-out audio only if the shop has a cable that connects the piano's headphone out to the phone. Otherwise close mic plus an on-screen note that the recording is from a phone. Not a Thompson arm; measured against the channel's own median.

channels.role:
The primary feed test surface from week 1. Location tag «Астана» on every post, and the address on the end frame (never in the first 2 s).

Trust shelf:
- pinned «Как заказать пианино»;
- highlights for «Гарантия и сервис» (exact site wording, including Casio service in Almaty and how the shop handles repairs once the owner confirms), «Доставка и оплата» (plus instalments if confirmed), «Возврат 14 дней — условия» and «Отзывы» (public, anonymised).

Prefilled wa.me in the bio. Insights access is requested so we can read the share of Astana viewers. Until then, weekly screenshots.

channels.channel: Music-school teachers and class parent WhatsApp chats (new local distribution track)
channels.role:
The real local channel where piano advice spreads.

- Week 1: the worker sends a forwardable card (a 9:16 CHECK-03 still plus the address plus code РОДИТЕЛИ1) to 5–10 teachers already in the shop's contacts or visiting the store. Shop business cards with the code handwritten go to teachers who come in (assumes the shop has cards).
- TEACH-09 invites teachers publicly, and their code is ПЕДАГОГ1.
- Physical visits to nearby ДМШ fall outside the 20-minute content budget and happen only if the owner assigns time (owner ask).
- No commissions or incentives unless the owner creates them.

If the owner confirms an account or agrees to open a business account, it becomes the fastest test surface from week 2, with the same bodies. Feed reach here skews non-local, so TikTok is judged on codes from Astana, not on views.

All shorts are cross-posted to Shorts. The search line carries plain model-name comparisons (L002/L004), starting with PX-770 vs AP-270 in week 4. wa.me goes in descriptions. Measured against the channel's own median per format.

If a Kaspi shop or Kaspi instalment exists, CTAs may point to it with the exact confirmed terms, and attribution adds promoted vs unpromoted piano SKU lift on Kaspi (weak). If not, Kaspi is mentioned only as a published payment method.

Transaction point for RK delivery. A weekly crawl of piano prices (7-day TTL, re-fetched on publish day) and stock_qty, used for the R9 stock guardrail and a weak difference-in-differences attribution.
The «is it real / is it open?» check, given «Финальная распродажа». A monthly photo refresh from the shoots. Satisfied buyers are asked for reviews with an owner-approved message. No incentives.
Mirror cross-posts at 0 minutes. No decisions are made on their data.
None (0 ₸). If the owner later approves a budget and a cost cap, R3 candidates get an Astana-radius click-to-WhatsApp boost.

measurement.success_metric:
Business: digital pianos sold and attributed by 2026-12-31.

The target is assumed at +10 attributed sales ≈ 50 coded inquiries (assumed 20% inquiry-to-order rate). It is replaced by the owner's Q2 number and the chat-sample rate.

Thompson reward: E-score = √(rel_reach × rel_actions) at T+7d, scored as beating the median.
- YouTube is normalised against the channel's own median.
- Instagram and TikTok use the pooled music-retail median, a hypothesis until there are 10 posts per platform.
- The reward switches to coded piano WA inquiries per 1k reach at ≥10 coded inquiries in a rolling 4 weeks.

Tail: ≥1 post at ≥5× the median by 20 Dec (likely, not guaranteed).

2. The WA logger records code → model → city → instalment asked Y/N → sold Y/N, weekly (daily in the push).
3. Weak signals: promoted vs unpromoted piano SKU stock_qty on the site (difference-in-differences), plus Kaspi SKU lift if a Kaspi shop is confirmed.
4. Uncoded inquiries are logged «без кода» and never claimed.

measurement.review_cadence:
- Per post: T+48h (R1) and T+7d (reward).
- Monday: posteriors, R4 allocation, TTL re-fetch, the shoot card (≤10 min, ≤2 pianos).
- Wednesday: owner one-tap approval.
- Friday: code log.
- Weekly: ≤5-line RU report to the boss.
- Every 2 weeks: R7 funnel check.
- Checkpoints: 2026-11-02 recalibration; 2026-11-22 for ≥10 coded inquiries, SMP lock and R8; 2026-12-20 switch to the push mix; 2026-12-31 final attribution.

decision_rules: Mix: 50/35/15 (hero / proof+utility / conversion) to 20 Dec with exploration ≥25%; 30/30/40 on 21–31 Dec with exploration ≥15%.

SKU priority rule. Hero and utility slots go to SKUs with ≥3 units on the site, re-read weekly: EDP-220BK, PX-S1100, AP-300WE, CUP E1/M1, and PX-770/AP-270 on the YouTube line. A 1-unit SKU never gets a hero slot. If a priority SKU drops below 2, its slots move to the next most-stocked in-stock model.

Show-not-hear rule. Hero episodes argue only with visible, ledger-backed differences. A sound A/B may run only as one exploration slot, and only if two staff told the pianos apart on a cheap Android in the week-0 test and the boss approved after listening. Line-out recording is used only with a cable the shop already has. A 10× sound comparison never runs.
G4 tightening (my call, beyond the slate): no ₸ figure in the first 2 seconds of any video. Prices and gaps appear from 2 s onward, inside the story.

Casio service disclosure rule. Full disclosure (2-year warranty, service in Almaty) goes in the WA reply when asked and on the trust highlight in exact site wording. It is never in a hook or a recurring Status. In videos the warranty line is «гарантия 2 года, по гарантийному случаю — [как магазин организует ремонт]», published only after the owner confirms the procedure. It is never hidden.

Instalment gate (Q1). If instalments are confirmed, «от X ₸/мес» goes into TIERS-07, GIFT-05 and FIRSTYEAR-15 with the provider and exact terms, owner sign-off on every post, and no «0%» unless confirmed. If they are not confirmed, no monthly figures appear anywhere, and FIRSTYEAR-15 runs the entry-tier version.

Local rule. Every video ends on «Астана, Кажымукана 14 · WhatsApp: слово ___» with an Instagram location tag. If coded inquiries from outside Astana exceed 50% without sales, CTAs are re-weighted toward the free RK delivery fact.

Shoot rule. Each weekly session uses ≤2 pianos and ≤3 setups and takes ≤10 minutes, with the printed preset/volume/framing checklist taped to each piano. A shot that is skipped is replaced by reuse, never by AI depicting the product.
R1 Rescue at T+48h: rel_hold3 < 0.7 → re-cut with the next hook variant and repost ≥72 h later, once. If hold is fine but completion < 0.7, bring the payoff forward next time.
R2 Iterate on any post at ≥2× the median: a new pair on the same device, the same insight on a new engine, and an E19 reply.
R3 Scale on a post at ≥3× the median with ≥1 code: pin it, add it to Status and the teacher card. Paid only if approved.

R4 Allocate every Monday across A1 hero, A2 utility, A3 parent/teacher question and A4 gift (from 1 Dec) by 1 000 Thompson draws. Exploration ≥25%, cap 50% per arm, ≥1 slot every 2 weeks until 6 posts.
R5 Retire an arm if P(success rate > 0.5) < 0.15 after ≥8 posts.
R6 Report honestly: P(beats median) plus an 80% interval, «пока похоже, что…».
R7 Funnel check every 2 weeks: if E is rising but codes are flat, fix the CTA, the codes, reply time, the pinned video and the instalment info before making more content.
R8 Rethink: no arm at P > 0.6 and fewer than 10 codes by 22 Nov → rerun C with the chats and micro-voice, and propose a non-discount offer.
R9 Stock: re-check on publish day. A promoted SKU at 0 has its posts pulled and swapped. Never promote out-of-stock SKUs.

Truth gates: every price or gap literal is re-fetched within 7 days before publishing. Spec claims are made only from fetched spec cards. CHECK-03's generic checks are worded and approved by the store.
Q2 gate: until it is answered, no «распродажа» and no deadlines. If the store is closing, all warranty and after-sales lines pause.
Q3 gate: no «до 31-го» or «успеем к Новому году» without owner cut-offs.
CTA gate: «покажем рядом / приходите» CTAs only if the owner confirms showroom try-out. Otherwise the CTA is «пришлём, чем отличаются эти модели».
learning_questions: Does showing the difference (key action, pedals, stand, headphones, body) earn more saves and codes than reading it from spec cards? And does a sound A/B, if it passes the gate, add anything beyond that?
Does instalment framing («от X ₸/мес») raise coded inquiries and the inquiry-to-order rate on 230k–755k ₸ models, compared with full-price framing?
Does the teacher/parent-chat track (РОДИТЕЛИ1, ПЕДАГОГ1) produce more Astana inquiries per minute of effort than feed reach?
Which hero pair converts: same price / different piano (CUP E1 vs M1), the budget step (EDP-220BK vs PX-S1100), or the 3× gap (EDP-220BK vs AP-300WE)? Do sales follow stock depth?

Which tension actually moves Astana buyers: price vs what you get (INS1), the child quitting (INS4), spec confusion (INS3), the teacher's opinion (INS7) or the gift moment (INS2)? This decides the SMP lock on 22 Nov.
Is the bottleneck consideration, or conversion (chats dying at price or instalments, slow replies)?
What share of coded inquiries come from Astana vs regions, and does free RK delivery convert regional buyers?
Do teacher comments under TEACH-09 give material for E19 replies that outperform the originals?

owner_asks.ask: 2) «Что для вас победа к 31.12 и почему именно к Новому году? Что значит «Финальная распродажа» — закрытие, уход бренда или акция со сроком? По умолчанию: цель +10 продаж по кодовым словам, в первую очередь Estrada EDP-220BK, Casio PX-S1100, AP-300 белое, Kurzweil CUP E1/M1; без слова «распродажа» и без дедлайнов.»

owner_asks.why: Nothing posts without approval. Access goes through Andrey and Pavel, so a fixed slot avoids latency.

risks: Show-not-hear depends on real visible differences. If the spec cards for CUP E1 vs M1 show nothing visible, BLIND-01 falls back to a no-claim «какое поставили бы дома?» look comparison, and the pair goes to YouTube only.

Honest «what's in the box» content may show the PX-S1100 needs a stand or pedals bought separately. That is true and useful, but may cool interest. It is answered with the full price of the set only if those accessories are in the ledger, and the owner approves.

Instalment advertising counts as financial services in RK (my judgment beyond the method). Conservative wording, the provider named, exact terms, no «0%» unless confirmed, owner sign-off on every post. If the terms change, the posts are pulled.
Owner access only through Andrey and Pavel: defaults on every question, a fixed Wednesday slot, and claim-free bodies (TEACH-09, the no-claim CHECK-03 version) ready to go if approvals lag.
«Финальная распродажа» may mean closure. The Q2 gate pauses all warranty lines, and no «распродажа» wording is used.
Ledger gaps: the new hero prices come from our 2026-10-08 crawl and expire 15 Oct. Everything is re-fetched before publishing, and a mismatch blocks the post.

Teacher outreach could exceed the worker budget, and could look like soliciting if done clumsily. It is limited to existing contacts and store visitors within ≤6 min. School visits happen only if the owner assigns time. No incentives without an owner-created offer.
Feed reach may still skew non-local. Mitigations are the location tag, the address end frame, the РОДИТЕЛИ1/ПЕДАГОГ1 track, and judging TikTok by Astana codes rather than views.

Smaller sessions mean TIERS-07 and STAKES-11 slip to week 3, so the week 1–2 exploration portfolio is 7 posts, slightly below the 8–12 guideline. That is accepted for feasibility, and hook variants add data points.
Thin evidence: the SMP is provisional. INS1 supplies 3 of 9 ideas (33%), within the 40% cap. Re-ranked after the chat sample.
Conversion may be the real bottleneck (reply time, instalments, chats dying after price). Content can't fix that, so R7 checks it every 2 weeks.
December logistics: no timing promises without Q3. Otherwise conversion relies on pickup and reserve.

Low base rate at 0 ₸ for a high-ticket item with a long research phase. The +10 target may not be reachable organically. That will be said honestly on 22 Nov, together with the levers: more posts, an approved offer, an approved paid boost.
